questions.question: Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2014 season?
In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Cobras or Knights?
At which ground did Yolandi van der Westhuizen record their career-best innings (114*, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Boland Park, Paarl, against Kei on 2014/01/12.

questions.question: At which ground did Eastern Storm record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Uplands College — largest win by runs of 218, against Rhinos on 2025/03/01.

questions.question: At Recreation Ground, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (T20)?
questions.explanation: Jané Winster holds it with 26, a joint record shared with Micaela Andrews.

questions.question: How many maidens separate the all-time #1 (Michelle Botha) and #2 (Alicia Smith) bowlers (combined T20 + List A) in the 16/17 season?
questions.explanation: Michelle Botha: 23 — Alicia Smith: 20 — a gap of 3.
